🎓 Research Grant Opportunities 2026

December 20, 2025
Research Council
7 min read
🎓

Exciting Opportunities for Student Researchers

The university is committed to fostering research excellence among its students. This year, we have allocated substantial funding for student research projects across multiple disciplines. These grants provide an excellent platform for students to conduct meaningful research while contributing to their respective fields.

Research Grant Categories

  • Undergraduate Research Grant: Up to ₹50,000 for final-year projects
  • Graduate Research Fellowship: Up to ₹2,00,000 for two-year research
  • Interdisciplinary Innovation Grant: Up to ₹1,50,000 for collaborative projects
  • Social Impact Research Grant: Up to ₹1,00,000 for research addressing social challenges
  • Publication Support Fund: Up to ₹30,000 for journal article publication fees

Eligibility Requirements

Undergraduate students must be in their final year with a CGPA above 3.3. Graduate students can apply at any stage of their program with departmental approval. All applicants must have a faculty mentor and a well-defined research proposal addressing gaps in current knowledge.

Selection Criteria

The Research Council evaluates proposals based on originality, feasibility, potential impact, and methodological rigor. We particularly encourage research that aligns with sustainable development goals and addresses real-world problems. Diversity of research topics and student backgrounds are also considered important factors.

Application Process & Timeline

Applications will be accepted through our online portal from January 5 to February 28, 2026. Each proposal must include a comprehensive research plan, literature review, timeline, and budget justification. Shortlisted candidates will present their proposals before a selection panel in March, with final announcements by April 10.

Support Beyond Funding

Grant recipients receive additional mentorship, access to research facilities, funding for conference presentations, and support in publishing results. The university believes in nurturing the next generation of researchers and provides comprehensive support throughout the research journey.
